guard/30578.htm.text: Centurion Nakusin: I, Nakusin, am a Centurion, charged with guarding the Temple of Paagrio and Orc Village. This holy place must be kept pure, and I'll personally find and send to hell anyone who dares even to try to desecrate it!

links.text: "Tell me about the Temple of Pa'agrio."
"Who is the Lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

guard/30578-1.htm.text: Centurion Nakusin: The Pa'agrio Temple is a sacred place for worshipping Paagrio, the god of flame, creator of the Orcs. Every newborn Orc is raised to be proud of the Orc heroes here. Do you understand?

Q00004_LongLiveThePaagrioLord/30578-00.h.text: Centurion Nakusin: Dekara Lamchar Kakai! I have no time to waste with other races' runts! Go away! (Only Orcs may undertake this quest.)
